ICYMI, plus a reminder that the monthly mailbag for @winnipegfreepress.com is open a bit longer, so get your Winnipeg Jets questions in to @mikemcintyrewpg.bsky.social and me 👇

Capitals announce they've claimed Jack St. Ivany off waivers from the Jets. 

Picking up a right-handed D helps a little with Vincent Desharnais out 4-6 following appendectomy. 

Also, Rasmus Sandin -- a left-handed D, who played right side last season -- still out maybe a month or so more.
And here’s my story on the legacy of Connor Hellebuyck and how his departure could affect that, both now and down the road 👇
Hers’s the first leg of our double coverage of the trade involving the Winnipeg Jets and New Jersey Devils 👇

Considering the urge for the #Jets to build a team that can be competitive right away, it’s of a surprise the only skater they got in the Hellebuyck trade who will make an immediate impact is Dawson Mercer.

Command & prospects will help them in the long run, not now #NHLJets
